# Set up

Load needed packages, make sure they are installed.

```{r}
library(readr) 
library(dplyr) 
library(tidyverse) 
library(skimr) 
library(here)
```

Load the data.

```{r}
#EXAMPLE!!!!!! Path to data. Note the use of the here() package and not absolute paths
data_location <- here::here("Data","raw_data","Data/raw-data/TB_data_dictionary_2026-09-25.csv")
#load data
data_dictionary <- read_csv(data_location)
